subject: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, the next step is a technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineering team to review integration surface area (API keys, data flows, KV caching), and a short security touchpoint for your Infosec folks to confirm data residency and audit log behavior.

High-level asks:
- 60–75 minute session: 45–50 mins SE demo + 15–20 mins security Q&A
- Participants: your infra/eng contact, a procurement or sourcing rep if you want to cover purchase timeline, and our SEs (Hannah + Dylan)
- Please share any blockers or specific compliance docs you need in advance (SOC2 artifacts, retention policy)

Can you share 3 windows next week that work for your team? We’ll propose one and send an invite. I attached a one-page pre-demo checklist to help your security folks.

Attachments: acme_pre-demo_checklist.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <security@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud

Hi Ben —

Thanks, that sounds good. Our initial windows next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-09 10:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-11-10 14:00–15:30
- Thu 2026-11-11 08:30–10:00

Priya (CC’d) will join for the security portion. Procurement (Tina) is included if we want to touch on timelines — Tina, are you available on any of the above?

Two asks from our side:
1) Can the SEs show how the KV cache interacts with our session model? We have a stateful inference flow and want to understand latency trade-offs.
2) Can you share SOC2 scope and a short note on data retention limits?

Alex
Alex Rivera
Staff Engineer — Platform | AcmeCloud
alex.rivera@acmecloud.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud

Alex —

Thanks for the windows. All three work for the SE team; prefer Tue 11/9 10:00 PST to get ahead of the holiday. We’ll plan for 75 minutes to leave time for procurement questions.

We’ll cover:
- Integration architecture overview (10 mins)
- Live demo showing session KV cache behavior and latency benchmarks (30 mins)
- Deployment/quantization recommendations for cost/latency (15 mins)
- Security Q&A with Priya (15–20 mins)

We’ll bring a small repro and an example workload; if you can share a short example (payload sizes, typical sequence lengths) that helps us pick the right model and quantization profile.

I’ve attached a draft agenda and a one-page checklist Ben sent.

Attachments: se_deep-dive_agenda_v1.docx, acme_pre-demo_checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

From: Tina Lopez <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <security@acmecloud.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud

Hi all —

I can do Tue 11/9 10:00 PST. Procurement will join for the last 15 minutes to align on timelines and initial contract questions. For the contract side, please send a short statement of work draft or standard terms we can review prior to the call.

Also: we need to confirm data residency options and whether audit logs can be retained for 24 months. Priya, can you coordinate any additional compliance questions during the call?

Thanks,
Tina Lopez
Senior Sourcing Specialist | AcmeCloud Procurement
procurement@acmecloud.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SE deep-dive + security touchpoint for AcmeCloud

Perfect — locking Tue 2026-11-09 10:00–11:15 PST.

I’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) with the attached agenda and the short pre-demo checklist. We’ll also share a single-page SOC2 scope note ahead of the call for Priya and procurement.

Action items before the demo:
- Alex: if you can drop a sample payload example (max tokens, typical sequence length) in the linked Drive folder, Hannah can tune the demo workload.
- Priya: any must-see compliance artifacts we should bring for the Q&A?
- Tina: we’ll share a basic SOW template by EOD Tuesday for your review.

Attachments: redwood_calendar_invite.ics, se_deep-dive_agenda_v1.docx, acme_pre-demo_checklist.pdf

Thanks everyone — see you on 11/9.

Ben Carter
